    Goto SpawnFinished
  DRLASpawn:
    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("RLMegasphere", 0,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION)
    TNT1 AA 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("LDLiteDRLARandomPowerup", 0,0,0, frandom(-1.0,1.0),frandom(-1.0,1.0),frandom(0.3,1.0), 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION)

    Goto SpawnFinished
  GunCasterSpawn:
	TNT1 A 0 A_DropItem("TreasureChest",-1,256)
    Goto SpawnFinished
  HDSpawn:
    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("Megasphere", 0,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION)
    TNT1 A 0 A_SpawnItemEx ("HDBlurSphere", 0,0,0, 0,0,0, 0, SXF_NOCHECKPOSITION)

    TNT1 A 0 RSQLDL_HDCurser(0, 0)

  SpawnFinished:

  }
}
